canonical.head: c42db098cc246e3da06472a34979bdf24cfa81cb
canonical.relevant_delta: Since F-GC44 close, canonical added F-GC45 qualification/test support and publication/docs; no src/** delta affecting Hupsel application, irrigation, PMdirect, drainage, solver or reference authority.

authority.irrigation_source_semantics: exact B1.11 irrigation.f90; qualification-only observation write added after Irrigation task-3 selection/rate calculation
authority.noninstrumented_source_delta: mechanical GNU portability selection as already qualified; observation campaign source differs from the corresponding B1.11 GNU qualification copy only in irrigation.f90 instrumentation

exact_route_contract.fixed_event: SWIRFIX=1 inline event, IRTYPE=1 surface irrigation, exact event time match, gird=rate, duration=depth/rate
exact_route_contract.scheduled_outer_gate: schedule=1, no fixed event already selected, crop emerged and irrigation window open
exact_route_contract.TCS1: tps1=AFGEN(TREL,DVS); Tred=1-(iqreddry_day+iqredsol_day)/iptra_day when iptra_day>1e-10 else 1; trigger when Tred<tps1
exact_route_contract.TCSFIX: trigger survives only when dayfix>=IRGDAYFIX; accepted trigger resets dayfix to 1
exact_route_contract.DCS2: depth_cm=0.1*AFGEN(FID,DVS); Hupsel table is constant 20 mm
exact_route_contract.application: ISUAS=0 sprinkling; positive regular rate, gird=irr_rate and dt_event=depth/rate; qssdi remains zero

existing_capability_disposition.fixed_event_process: existing F-PM03/F-VQ18 provides qualified fixed-event process semantics, but M1-C3 still requires the legacy-file/application composition for this exact Hupsel event
existing_capability_disposition.F_PM04_F_VQ20: scientifically qualified TCS7+DCS2 single-node SSDI capability is NOT the active Hupsel route and must not be used as a substitute
existing_capability_disposition.active_Hupsel_scheduled_route: TCS1+DCS2 sprinkling with TCSFIX=1; currently uncovered

next_permitted_action: After F-APP05 admission, admit the stateless SWINTER=0/SWCF=0 PMdirect identity route and open one bounded Hupsel irrigation composition capability covering the exact fixed surface event plus scheduled TCS1+DCS2 sprinkling/TCSFIX=1 envelope. Do not reuse TCS7 SSDI as proxy.
